title: Beast-folk rebuilt in 3D
changes: The beast-folk of the Mawdeep Warrens (rat, boar, spider and bat kin, the crow seer, the gnasher, the weaver, the packlord, the horn brute and the Hide-Mother) are now built as 3D models and drawn as pixel art: animal heads with snouts, tusks, horns and fangs, flayed hoods, naked tails, spider legs and wings that beat.
Flying beast-folk now hover over their shadow. Same size on screen and no cost to performance.
